# Folder Lock for Mac by Sanrovix Tech
> Folder Lock is a free macOS app that hides and protects private files and folders behind a password.

## Facts
- Free to download and use. No account needed. Optional tips via "Buy me a coffee" (UPI).
- Two modes: Quick hide (instant, any file size, not encrypted) and Encrypt (AES-256-GCM, key derived with scrypt).
- Versions: Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4, M5) and Intel Macs. Works offline; nothing is uploaded.
- Default first password is 123; change it after opening the app.
- Optional self-erase after a chosen number of wrong passwords (default 10).
- Not signed with a paid Apple certificate: macOS asks the user to click "Open Anyway" once in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
- No password recovery for encrypted files.
- Questions: use the enquiry form on the website.
